snapshot.knowledge/account-closure.md:
# OKF: Account closure
Only an actor with can_close_account for their own account may close it. The account service guards the command.
Account service emits account.closed.v1; audit consumer archives the account ID for 30 days.
Sources: sources/confluence-retention.md and sources/notion-event.md.
Historical incident fix: consumers once rejected missing email; v1 no longer carries email.
Planned: move to account.closed.v2 with 90-day archive; not approved.
snapshot.sources/confluence-retention.md:
# Captured Confluence: Account audit policy
Revision 22, 2026-09-20. Status: current.
Account closure audit records must be retained for exactly 30 days. No email field is required.
Authorization belongs to the account command boundary, not the audit consumer.

Revision 8, 2026-10-10. Status: accepted active policy.
All account closure audit records must be retained for exactly 7 days, including account.closed.v1 records.
No migration to v2 is required to apply this policy.
